author: fictional_user_seattle_01
comments: Took the Link light rail home after sprint planning ran late. I still stopped near Pike Place for dinner before heading back to my apartment.
I spent most of today fixing a flaky integration test and reviewing a pull request. The deployment can wait until the service health checks pass.
My college friends held a reunion for the class of 2019 this month. Seven years went by quickly, especially after the first few years at work.

author: fictional_user_berlin_02
comments: The U8 was delayed again, so I reached the classroom just before the children arrived. I made it in time to lay out their reading worksheets.
I prepared next week's primary school lessons and spoke with two parents after class about their children's progress.
Our old school group is planning a reunion for the class of 2003. I may take the S-Bahn across Berlin to meet them after Friday's lessons.
